vitest_missing: Vitest is not installed in the project ({detail}). Install it with: npm install --save-dev vitest (or point JGATES_VITEST to the executable).
vitest_no_version: Could not read the Vitest version at {path}. Reinstall with: npm install --save-dev vitest.
vitest_timeout: Vitest exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended.
vitest_invalid_output: The Vitest report is not the expected JSON: {detail}
vitest_no_invocation: The plan has no Vitest invocation for the instance {tool}.
vitest_coverage_missing: Vitest ran with coverage, but the summary was not read: {detail}
vitest_coverage_provider_missing: The coverage provider {provider} is not installed, and JGates installs nothing during a run. Install it with: npm install --save-dev {provider}@{version}
vitest_coverage_provider_mismatch: The installed {provider} ({found}) is not the Vitest version ({version}). Align it with: npm install --save-dev {provider}@{version}
vitest_threshold_generic: Vitest rejected the coverage by the project's thresholds
vitest_condition_executes: Runs the project's tests (and its configuration and setup files); outputs only in the run folder.
vitest_condition_config_none: No configuration file: Vitest uses its defaults.
vitest_condition_shadowed: {config} prevails over {shadowed}: Vitest does not read the Vite file when a vitest.config exists.
vitest_condition_provider_missing: Coverage selected, but {provider} is not installed: the coverage stage will be blocked and nothing will be installed.
vitest_condition_provider_mismatch: Coverage selected, but the installed {provider} ({found}) is not the Vitest version ({version}): the coverage stage will be blocked.
